Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Monica (procurement) and Marissa (finance) are copied to complete the vendor record and queue the ACH verification.

Short answers up front:
- We can support micro-deposits (preferred) OR prenote. Micro-deposits will move faster for our finance ops if your team can verify the amounts within 72 hours.
- For remittance, please include the PO in the payment reference using the format RDW-45219:PO12345 (finance will use that token to auto-match).

Next steps I can action from my side:
1) Monica: please confirm the vendor category and attach the final vendor code to the PO.
2) Marissa: when you kick off verification, please set expected ACH clear date and add the remittance token in the payment metadata.
3) Liam: if you prefer DocuSign for the enrollment packet sign-off, we'll accept the envelope link and finalize.

I'll also attach the PO link for your records: https://app.redwood.com/po/RDW-45219

Thanks — look forward to closing this out this week.

— Rishi

Thanks Rishi — micro-deposits it is. I've just sent the enrollment packet via DocuSign (envelope: DocuSign_PaymentEnrollment.pdf). Our payments team (payments@sparktide.com) will verify and confirm micro-deposit amounts as soon as they land. Expect confirmation within 48–72 hours.

A couple of notes for your AP team:
- Remittance format: please include both the Redwood PO token and the invoice number. Example: RDW-45219:INV-7721
- We request sent-remit notifications (email to payments@sparktide.com) when the payment is issued so our reconciliation can close.

Attachment: DocuSign_PaymentEnrollment.pdf (signed envelope sent)

Cheers,
Liam
